arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import statistics
import math

# Paper money in circulation (in millions) for FY 1941-1950
# From 1950 bulletin (more recent) and 1948 bulletin where 1950 doesn't have 1941-1942
paper_money = [8932, 11600, 16492, 21438, 25511, 26945, 26942, 26182, 26034, 25661]

# FY 1945: 1950 bulletin says 25511 vs 1948 bulletin 25541 - using more recent
# FY 1948: 1950 bulletin says 26182 vs 1948 bulletin 26482 - using more recent (1950 bulletin)

print('Paper money data:', paper_money)
print('Count:', len(paper_money))
print('Mean:', statistics.mean(paper_money))

n = len(paper_money)
mean = statistics.mean(paper_money)
s = statistics.stdev(paper_money)  # sample stdev (n-1 denominator)

print('Sample stdev (s):', s)

# Fisher excess kurtosis (bias-corrected)
# Formula: ((n*(n+1))/((n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3))) * sum(((x-mean)/s)**4) - 3*(n-1)**2/((n-2)*(n-3))
m4 = sum(((x - mean) / s) ** 4 for x in paper_money)
g2 = (n * (n + 1)) / ((n - 1) * (n - 2) * (n - 3)) * m4 - 3 * (n - 1) ** 2 / ((n - 2) * (n - 3))

print('m4:', m4)
print('Fisher excess kurtosis:', g2)
print('Rounded to thousandths:', round(g2, 3))
"

factor2 = 3 * (n - 1)**2 / ((n - 2) * (n - 3))

print('factor2 =', factor2)

g2 = factor1 * m4 - factor2
